'''Co'overma''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], who along with [[Liefur]] came to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to preserve local wildlife, specifically wild [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]]. They asked a passerby to release the nexu captured and held by the pirates.<ref name="Making Trouble" />
